{{recipe}}

One variety of [[Cookbook:Swallow|swallow]] in Nigeria is that made of wheat [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]. It is served with various soups and stews, such as [[Cookbook:Egusi Soup|ẹgusi]], [[Cookbook:Nigerian Okra Soup|okro]], or [[Cookbook:Ogbono Soup|ogbono]] soups.

==Ingredients==
*Water
*Wheat [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]

==Procedure==
#Put water in a pot, and bring it to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
#Gradually stir in the flour, mixing until the mixture is thick and lump-free.
#Add a small amount of water, and cook for few minutes.
#Serve with the soup of your choice.
